name: pdf-editor
description: Pixel-Perfect PDF Visual Editor with Spring Boot backend and Vue 3 frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cd backend && mvn spring-boot:run" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cd backend && mvn clean package -DskipTests" "cd frontend && npm run build"
